name: open hq dropdown

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto http://localhost:3086/agents-flow`. The dashboard now gates on an API token and the setup wizard, so an unauthenticated visit lands on /login or /setup and `.hq-menu-trigger` never appears. goto-view seeds both and waits for the shell; it also honours the configured baseUrl instead of hardcoding the host.

expect: hq-dropdown shows the Create section + a View section with 5 toggles (Live meeting, Meetings panel, Management log, Performance HUD, Giro/rotation), each with a check mark when active
